decisions.quote: Other than increases in effect size coverage, instructors’ estimates of class time devoted to critical reform topics have changed relatively little over nearly two decades, with significant attention often reserved for a rarely offered second-level, advanced class.
decisions.reason: Comparing the replication survey to the original 2000 survey, the authors report that class-time estimates for most critical reform topics and reliance on a rarely offered second-level course remained largely unchanged, but explicitly contrast this with increases in effect-size coverage. Because the paper presents tested findings that partly agree and partly differ from the original survey without a overriding whole-study verdict of full replication, the outcome is mixed.
